display.purpose: One per spread, grain-masked League Gothic caps.

masthead.purpose: ALWYN / TABLATIN hero pair; monumental by design.

headline.purpose: Records, quest names, skill group heads.

label.purpose: Folio, side-heads, toast, metadata; tracked caps.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--stock)
shadows.purpose: Focus only. The sole shadow-like value; keeps focus visible over halftone dots. No elevation shadows exist.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Zone colour cross-fade (0.7s), nav underline, chevrons, XP fill.

motion.name: press-wipe-black-plate
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0), 0.9s expo.out, group stagger 0.1s, once
motion.purpose: Black plate lays down left to right.

motion.name: press-spot-plate
motion.value: from translate(-18px, 10px), delay 0.25s, 1.2s expo.out, settles at translate(3px, -2px)
motion.purpose: Spot plate lands late and out of register.

motion.name: scroll-slip
motion.value: velocity/2600 clamped to +-1, smoothing 0.14, plate translate = (3 + 10s)px, (-2 - 5s)px
motion.purpose: Scroll speed pushes the spot plate out of register; returns within about 1.8s.

motion.name: camera-dwell
motion.value: 440px of scroll to reach a stop, clamped 0.1 to 0.4 of spread
motion.purpose: Camera arrives, holds while reading, leaves in the last stretch.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms; press run and camera slip not run; static halftone backdrop

components.name: Button
components.description: Opaque stock block with ink hairline; inverts to ink on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Spot-filled block for the one main action of a spread.

components.name: Numeral Block
components.description: Square spot block carrying a League Gothic numeral; the main carrier of the spread spot.

components.name: Chapter Tab
components.description: Masthead cell: spot numeral, tracked-caps label, 4px ink underline grows on the active spread.

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Ruled index row: display headline left, detail and chips right, tenure or level bar underneath.

components.name: Locked Slot
components.description: Unearned achievement printed as a dashed empty slot.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Square ink block with foam tracked-caps text.

narrative.overview:
The site is one issue of a surf-culture music magazine, laid out by someone who treats collisions as craft. A continuous halftone 3D "photograph" sits behind the page and is flown by scroll, one sculpture per spread, and the type is printed straight through it. Everything is uncoated stock, dense ink and one loud spot colour per spread. Panels are hairline-ruled, square and flat. Nothing glows, floats or rounds.

Density is editorial: monumental condensed caps against small, quiet Archivo reading text, divided by 1px ink rules like a layout grid. The RPG vocabulary stays in the copy and the game mechanics stay in the product, dressed as magazine furniture: an issue folio, chapter numbers, index rows, registration marks.

The one authored motion moment is the press run: each spread arrives like a sheet off a two-colour press, black plate first, spot plate a beat late and out of register, then settling.
keyCharacteristics: Four uncoated stocks, one ink, three spots, one spot per spread.
League Gothic caps at monumental scale, grain baked into the glyphs; Archivo for everything read.
1px ink hairlines are the only structure. No radii, no shadows, no glow.
Small copy always sits on an opaque stock plate when it overlaps the 3D layer.
Halftone ink-dot 3D at 45 degrees with the spot screen at 15 degrees.
Static and complete when motion or WebGL is unavailable.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: Each spread has exactly one spot colour, used on its loudest fragments (numeral blocks, primary button, highlighted headline word, primary skill row, XP fill). A second spot on the same spread is a defect.

rules.name: The Spot-Text Rule
rules.body: The spot is text only where --spot-text says so. Heat is never small text on foam, and on haze and glass neither chartreuse nor heat is text at all; those zones map spot-text to ink and the spot appears as a fill with ink on it. Always pair a fill with --on-spot.

rules.name: The Pure Spot Rule
rules.body: On haze, glass, ink and in boss mode the spot plate prints with normal blend so the spot stays pure. Multiply (overprint) is reserved for foam and bleach.

rules.name: The Boss Inversion Rule
rules.body: Boss mode swaps the whole system to ink stock, foam text and chartreuse spot, overriding every zone.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Display type carries a 240px fractal-noise alpha mask so it reads as ink on stock, not vector fill.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display face for headlines, numerals and buttons; Archivo for everything else. No third family, no system display face.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Never set small copy directly on the 3D layer. Anything below headline size that overlaps the canvas sits on an opaque (or 88% stock on the hero pitch) plate with a hairline. Headlines may print straight through the sculptures because dot coverage is capped at 0.58.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, text-shadow, glow, blur or gradient fills for decoration.

dos: Do give each spread one spot and use it on numeral blocks, the primary button, one headline word and the XP fill.
Do put every piece of small copy that overlaps the 3D layer on an opaque stock plate with a hairline.
Do keep hairlines at 1px in `--fg`, and use dashed hairlines for empty or locked slots.
Do invert to ink on hover for buttons, tabs and rows.
Do switch to normal blend for the spot on haze, glass, ink and boss mode; keep multiply on foam and bleach.
Do use spot-text only where the zone table allows it, and `--on-spot` on every spot fill.
Do let the masthead and spread titles be monumental and overlap; keep the grain mask on display type.
Do keep all content in the DOM and the page complete without WebGL or motion.
donts: Don't use radii, box-shadows, text-shadows, glow, blur or gradient decoration.
Don't set small copy straight on the canvas.
Don't stack an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading.
Don't use more than one spot colour on a spread, or heat as small text on foam, or chartreuse or heat as text on haze or glass.
Don't add a third typeface, a system display face, or icon-font or glyph icons; icons are drawn SVG.
Don't return to neon, pixel or game-HUD styling, or a centred headline over a card grid.
Don't make the 3D dots merge to solid under headlines.
